title: Manager: small fixes left by task 061 (job b worktree, main-folder during a merge, rebuilt task's two worktrees, tests that read limits.json, a check on builder spend)
item: Fix the minor problems review 061-1 and advisor 061-1 left in the parallel manager, and add a script check for money a builder spends when its task has no outside_needs or cap
motivation: Review 061-1 minor 1-8 and advisor 061-1's notes; none blocked task 61. The task 61 builder spent about 0.59 USD on claude -p runs with no money field on the task: rule 2 says a broken rule that no script checks gets a task to build that check.
notes: Review 061-1: (1) step 8's job (b) brief does not pass the task's worktree that agents/advisor.md expects; (2) main-folder fails on a staged change, so running it while a step-7 merge --no-commit is open (a background builder returning mid-merge) ends the run with the merge open; the text should say to wait until the merge is committed or aborted; (3) after a failed main-folder check the text says change nothing on the working branch, but step 9 commits RUNS.md, and nothing covers agents still running; (4) a park removes one worktree, but a rebuilt task has two; (5) your own commit or tracked edit in the main folder during a run ends the run, and no doc tells you; (6) test_batch_hard_dependency_between_tasks's batch assertion passes without the dependency check; (7) tasks_at_once is not validated (0 or missing); (8) advisor.md's Never list does not name conflict and stale. Advisor 061-1: test_limits_tasks_at_once_starts_at_2 and the parallel test read the real limits.json, so they fail when you change tasks_at_once; SKILL.md rule 8 overstates the isolation: "worktree" result. Builder: the push hook refuses any Bash text containing the words of a push, even in a heredoc that writes docs; skill-iterate's commands/iterate.md still assumes the main folder (another skill); tasks.py next is kept beside batch. Dropped 2026-11-17: folded into task 066, the one manager loose-ends task. This file stays as the list of what task 066 fixes.
done_means: (1) While a manager run is active, the Bash hook that .claude/settings.json already registers refuses, with exit 2, a command whose text runs headless Claude Code (`claude -p` or `claude --print`) or the `ant` CLI, unless the command's text or the hook's cwd names the worktree of a task (`build/worktrees/task-<id>`, a rebuild's `-<n>` included) whose file on the working branch has `claude-api` in `outside_needs`. The refusal tells the agent to stop and report it, and names the park reason `money`. With no run active it refuses nothing, and .claude/settings.json is unchanged. Tests feed the hook stand-in events, make no paid call, and cover: a task without the need, refused; a task with it, allowed; a command that names no task worktree, refused; no active run, allowed; a command that runs neither program, allowed; the push refusals as before. (2) The rule is written where each reader meets it: SKILL.md says a builder spends money only when its task's `outside_needs` names the need and that the task otherwise parks (reason `money`), and lists the hook under What the scripts enforce with what it misses (a script or an SDK call) and what it over-refuses (it reads command text, so a heredoc that only quotes a push or a paid command is refused too); agents/builder.md tells the builder to run no paid command unless the brief quotes that need, to stop and report under Blocked when `done_means` cannot hold without one, and to write file text with Write or Edit, not a Bash heredoc; commands/manage.md step 4 quotes the task's `outside_needs` in the builder's brief and parks the task (reason `money`) when the builder stops on it. (3) commands/manage.md: step 8's brief for the advisor's job (b) gives `<worktree>` as the place to read the branch's files; `checks.py main-folder` is not run while step 7's merge is open in the main folder, and for an agent that returns meanwhile it runs right after that merge is committed or aborted; step 8 removes every worktree of the task's branches, so a parked task that was rebuilt leaves none that git allows to remove. (4) After a failed main-folder check the text no longer contradicts itself: it says whether step 9's run report is still committed (never while the main folder is off the working branch, never together with a file an agent changed), that nothing more is dispatched, merged or parked, and that a task whose agent is still running stays In progress with its branch and worktree for the next run-start to report; the message `checks.py main-folder` prints on a failure says the same. (5) SKILL.md tells the owner that his own commit on the working branch, or his edit to a tracked file in the main folder, during a run ends that run with nothing lost, and where he can work meanwhile; rule 8 says of the 2026-11-17 experiment only what tasks/advice/061-1.md records (with `cwd`, the builders' Bash ran in the main folder; with `isolation: worktree`, builders worked in their own worktree and Bash still wrote to the main folder when told to); agents/advisor.md's Never list names a second try-merge failure (`conflict`) and a stale iterate result (`stale`). (6) `tasks.py batch` with `tasks_at_once` missing from limits.json, or not an integer of 1 or more, exits non-zero with one line that names `tasks_at_once` and limits.json, with no traceback and not as no task to take; tests cover a missing key and 0. (7) No test's result depends on the values in the real limits.json: test repos get their own limits, and the one test that reads the real file checks only that both keys hold an integer of 1 or more. `test_batch_hard_dependency_between_tasks` keeps no assertion that still passes with the hard-dependency check taken out of `tasks.conflict`. (8) `uv run --with pytest pytest .claude/skills/manage/tests` passes, all of it, and `tasks.py lint` passes. The diff changes no file outside .claude/skills/manage/; `checks.py main-folder` still fails on a commit that is not the manager's; `tasks.py next` stays; the push refusal is not narrowed.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from review 061-1, advisor 061-1 and the task 061 builder's notes. Fields done_means, verified_by, may_edit, runs_as and depends_on drafted by the advisor (job d) from task 061 on 2026-11-17 (tasks/advice/064-1.md).

decided_for_you.chosen: Advisor job d drafted the fields from task 061, tasks/advice/064-1.md; line (1) adds a hook refusal of claude -p and ant while a run is active unless the task's outside_needs names claude-api
decided_for_you.would_change: If you want a money cap checked rather than permission, the hook registered under its own name in .claude/settings.json, or your own commits allowed during a run; see the reply's owner's calls 1-8
